events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 give 라이언 긱스 his senior debut as a substitute in a league match at Old Trafford, which ends in a 2–0 defeat to 에버턴 . Dean Saunders scores a hat-trick for 더비 카운티 in a 3-3 relegation crunch clash with 선덜랜드 at the Baseball Ground.
아스널 move three points clear at the top of the First Division by beating 리버풀 1–0 at Anfield thanks to a goal by Paul Merson .
페예노르트 's coaching staff, led by Gunder Bengtsson and 핌 베어벡 , is fired and replaced by former player Wim Jansen .
리버풀 go back to the top of the First Division by beating 선덜랜드 2–1 at Anfield.
아스널 return to the top of the First Division on goal difference (with a game in hand) by beating Leeds 2–0 at Highbury.
스윈던 타운 sell defender Paul Bodin to 크리스털 팰리스 for £550,000.
코번트리 시티 sign striker Robert Rosario from 노리치 시티 for £600,000.

리버풀 beat 더비 카운티 7–1 at the Baseball Ground , the first time in 28 years that a First Division team has scored seven goals away from home. 아스널's goalless draw at 노리치 시티 sends 리버풀 back to the top of the table.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign Soviet winger 안드레이 칸첼스키스 , 22, from FC 샤흐타르 도네츠크 for £1million. Ossie Ardiles leaves 스윈던 타운 to become the new manager of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 following the resignation of Jim Smith .
In the only league game of the day, Oldham and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain locked together at the top of the Second Division after a 1–1 draw at Boundary Park .
The 90-day inquest into the Hillsborough disaster records a verdict of accidental death on the 95 리버풀 fans who died as a result of their injuries at the FA Cup semi-final on 15 April 1989.
디에고 마라도나 is banned for fifteen months in the Italian Serie A after failing a drug test on cocaine .

맨체스터 유나이티드 centre-back 스티브 브루스 scores twice in a 3–0 away league win over his old club 노리치 시티, becoming the first defender to score ten league goals this season. 아스널 return to the top of the First Division by beating 더비 카운티 2–0 at the Baseball Ground, while 리버풀 suffer a shock 3–1 defeat at home to QPR.

March draws to a close with 아스널 leading 리버풀 by two points. 셰필드 유나이티드's incredible revival has continued as they now stand 12th in the table, but 더비 카운티 are twelve points adrift of safety, and 선덜랜드 occupy the other relegation place. 올덤 애슬레틱 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 lead the Second Division level on 70 points, with Brighton, 미들즈브러, 밀월 and 브리스틀 시티 occupying the playoff zone. Ossie Ardiles becomes manager of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who are just six points outside the playoff zone with two games in hand.
